items.title: 52263_Sonny Greer oral history interview
items.q: Bechet and Tricky and Bubba, every night was a jam session... them cats were jamming

ctx.x: How many people from the band in Washington ended up in the band in New York?
All of them. The Washingtonians. You mean ended up in the band. Charlie Hughes. Tricky replaced him. He got sick and Bubba went to -- Bubba went to Europe on his own, that's when -- no.
